AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 18, 2024
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Geetanjali Reuben, Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Dede Rossi, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner
Wayne Chaney Sr., Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54140  Recommendation to receive and file presentation for recognition of service to the
  Airport Advisory Commission by Commissioner Wayne Chaney Sr.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54132  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on June 20, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54133  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54157  Recommendation to establish an ad-hoc Committee for the limited purpose of
  recommending methods to increase attendance at and develop sponsorship
  opportunities for the 2024 Festival of Flight Event, with such Committee terminating
  upon the completion of the event.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54134  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54135  Recommendation to received and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for July 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 18, 2024
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

7.  24-54136  Recommendation to excuse Commissioners absent from the meeting of the Airport
  Advisory Commission on July 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Ken Mason, Executive Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Long Beach Airport at (562) 570-2619 or
LGBarpt@longbeach.gov.
